title: Runtime Application Compose Provider Binding Proof Manifest
description: Bounded USF-183 runtime proof manifest for API and worker dev runtime execution with SDK-backed Postgres, Keycloak, Mailpit, MinIO, NATS, Temporal, and OpenBao composed provider bindings, plus USF-189 explicit runtime provider dispositions for analytics, cache, search, scanner, mocks, backup/restore, and workflow automation provider classes. It records service catalogue traceability, teardown obligations, enterprise evidence posture, and explicit non-claims.
aiGuidance: This manifest supports bounded USF-183 runtime provider-binding proof only. It does not claim full dev readiness, full React parity, test readiness, staging readiness, production readiness, live-provider readiness, SOC readiness, or ISO/IEC 27001 certification.
